title: MICROMECH OF COMPOSITE MAT
description: An introduction to the constitutive modeling of composite materials: Green’s functions in heterogeneous media, Eshelby’s equivalent inclusion methods, eigenstrains, spherical and ellipsoidal inclusions, dislocations, homogenization of elastic fields, elastic, viscoelastic and elasto-plastic constitutive modeling, micromechanics-based models
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ENME E4113 ) or ENME E4113 ; Or instructor's approval.
raw_title_text: ENME E4115 MICROMECH OF COMPOSITE MAT. 3.00 points .
